title: MORE MORE JUMP! Chapter1 Episode1 Opening

rows.Line: I was born with bad luck.

If I went on a picnic, it would rain.
No amount of lucky weather charms ever worked.

My new hat would get blown away by a gust of wind,
           my favorite shoes would get splashed
                           by a passing car...

No matter how hard I tried,
so many things would still go wrong.
          And I just got sick of it...

That's when I saw Haruka on TV.
             She was an idol.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mom
rows.Line: Minori, your stomach medicine's on the living room table. Call me at work if you need anything, okay?

rows.Speaker: Little Minori
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Little Minori
rows.Line:
(I'm totally playing hooky today.
I know it's not good to, but I just don't feel like going...)

rows.Speaker: Little Minori
rows.Line: (Everyone's probably still angry at me for dropping the baton during that race...)

rows.Speaker: Little Minori
rows.Line:
(It's always like this...
I do everything I can, but things just never go well.)

rows.Speaker: Little Minori
rows.Line: If things are always going to end badly, maybe I should just stop trying...

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: Hi everyone! I'm Haruka Kiritani of ASRUN!

rows.Speaker: Little Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Little Minori
rows.Line: (Did Mom leave the TV on?)

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line:
I'll be singing solo for the first time today.
I'm really nervous, but I hope this song will cheer everyone up!

rows.Speaker: Little Minori
rows.Line: Is she an idol? She looks about my age!

rows.Speaker: Little Minori
rows.Line: Wow!

rows.Speaker: Little Minori
rows.Line: She's so pretty! And she's really good at dancing!

rows.Speaker: Little Minori
rows.Line: (She's sparkling... This is amazing!)

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks for listening!

rows.Speaker: Little Minori
rows.Line: (Would I be able to sing and dance like that too if I practiced real hard?)

rows.Speaker: Little Minori
rows.Line: But...even if I try, it'll just end up being...

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: Tomorrow will always be a better day!

rows.Speaker: Little Minori
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: It's my mission as an idol to give hope to everyone.

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: So I'll keep going! I'll keep trying to always be the idol who gives you hope for a better tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Little Minori
rows.Line: Tomorrow will always be a better day...

rows.Speaker: Little Minori
rows.Line:
Is that true?
If I keep trying, will my better tomorrow come one day too?

rows.Speaker: Little Minori
rows.Line: Okay. I'll go to school, apologize to everyone about the race, and promise to try harder!

rows.Speaker: Little Minori
rows.Line: (It's amazing how much that one sentence was able to cheer me up!)

rows.Speaker: Little Minori
rows.Line: Haruka Kiritani...
Some years later
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Please let my application be accepted this time!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! It's in the postbox. Now all I have to do is wait for the results to be... Wait, look at the time?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I need to hurry!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
One, two, three, four!
One, two, three... yikes!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ow...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Sigh... I can never get this part right.
Guess it's time to pack up for the day.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
N-No, wait! You can't just give up now, Minori!
Think about Haruka! Her training must be a million times tougher than this!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I just gotta have faith that tomorrow will always be a better day! And that my application will be accepted!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So I have to keep trying! Until I can become an idol like Haruka myself one day!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Did my phone just flash?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Untitled? I don't remember downloading this song.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh-What's happening?!
bgm_area00002

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ugh...
Where am I?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I was on the rooftop practicing...
How did I get here?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I must be dreaming...right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
This place kinda looks like a concert hall for idols.
Everything's so adorable!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Maybe I'll perform on a stage like this too one day...with Haruka! Naaah, there's no way.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hello, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wha?! Wh-Who are you?!
Hang on... Miku?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Don't forget about me!
Welcome to your SEKAI, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Rin's here too?! I knew it. This has to be a dream. How would I be talking with Miku and Rin otherwise?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's because this is your SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yes! A world born from all of your feelings!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And we're here because we want all of you to find your true feelings again, right here in this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right! Because when you do, those feelings will then give birth to songs.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
True feelings? Songs...? 
S-Stop! Hold it!
I have no idea what you're talking about at all...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hm? Not even an inkling?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But, well... It seems like you already know your true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: My true feelings?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What are you talking about?
Do you mean my dream to become an idol?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Maybe? Whatever the case, you should hold on to those feelings and never let them go.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Because all of the others are on the verge of forgetting about theirs.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um, can you be more specific?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's almost time for the show to start!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'll see you around, Minori! As long as you and the others have the same feelings, we'll all meet again in this SEKAI one day!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What she said! We're rooting for all of you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Uh, w-wait!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Atchoo!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wha-wha-wha? I fell asleep?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
On the roof, of all places...
I must be tired.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
And I was having this really funny dream, too...
Oh well! Back to practice!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Are my documents in order?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Yes, they are. Everything we need is here.
But...are you certain about this?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I am. I've already made up my mind...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm going to quit being an idol.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I think I've rested enough.
Time to get cracking on that part of the routine I keep tripping over!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: As long as I keep practicing, I'll definitely become an ideal idol like Haruka one day! More, more!

rows.Speaker: Movie
